description: He wears a knee-length reddish brown textured tunic with narrow gold-toned woven trim along the collar, cuffs, front edges and hem. A cream linen-like underlayer shows at the open neckline, wrists and lower front. A plain brown leather belt with a simple rectangular buckle shapes the waist, with a hanging belt end. Olive brown narrow trousers tuck into tall worn brown leather boots. The sleeves are full length; all garments are opaque. The clothing is practical, clean and well made, with restrained ornament rather than ceremonial display. Exact textile fibers cannot be confirmed visually. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
